source_claim: AlphaEvolve source metadata should include bounded evidence for the arXiv TeX/e-print archive in addition to PDF, abstract-page, and DOI/DataCite evidence.
claim_boundary: This boundary records the arXiv e-print endpoint, HTTP status, gzip content type, content-disposition filename, byte count, and SHA-256 digest for the AlphaEvolve source archive and is paired with the raw HTTP headers and retained archive sidecars. It does not claim extraction-script artifacts, TeX-source refresh gates, or cached-PDF header consistency.
